I know with Voat being fairly new and significantly quieter than the website-that-must-not-be-named, it's harder to continually generate a stream of original content, particularly on smaller subverses such as this one. That goes double when you consider how much effort it takes to make a decent amount of worldbuilding progress to then turn around and share it with us here. As a perfect example, I myself love worldbuilding but don't currently have anything developed to the point where I feel it is ready for public posting and feedback, and may not for some time.

 

So, I propose, as an effort to create some content in the meantime, we begin work on a world together, as a group. I am taking any and all suggestions on how to best go about this, but the way I imagine it is being one of potentially many /v/worldbuilding universes in which people can offer up their own ideas, suggestions, art, characters, and other pieces of the world to make it all come together in one big world. We can discuss in this thread what kind of world it is and who gets final say on what is and is not canon. So, let me hear your ideas! Do you want to build a world with me?
